metadata.title: Craftive — One platform, every configuration
metadata.description: Tell us your idea, and we'll guide your digital transformation. Craftive is a managed digital platform that handles setup, content, and publishing for brands and agencies.

hero.headline: Tell us your idea, and we'll guide your digital transformation
hero.subhead: We build your website, content infrastructure, and growth path for you. You focus on your business — we handle the technical side.

about.headline1: Build your brand on a ready foundation,
about.description: Your website shouldn't turn into a months-long project. We design your brand's content architecture together on our ready infrastructure — and once you go live, we keep running it.

features.headline: Modular. Secure. Ready on every channel.
features.subhead: Craftive isn't a collection of tools — it's a platform designed together for speed, security, analytics, and open API. Every capability complements the others; you don't need to set up any of them separately.

speed.title: Not months — weeks
speed.description: A typical corporate site takes 4–8 weeks. We don't start from scratch; we place your content on our ready foundation.
speed.kpiNote: Less than half the time of typical projects starting from zero

managedDelivery.title: Ready templates and process
managedDelivery.description: We don't reinvent the wheel for every client. We adapt our previously built templates and modules to your project, so time and budget are clear.

security.title: Security at every layer
security.description: From data to login, from API to content — protection exists at every point of the platform. Not complex technical details — just results: your data is safe.

features.title: Separate data vault
features.body: Each client's data is kept in a completely separate database. It never comes into contact with another account's data.

features.title: Two-factor login (2FA)
features.body: Admin login requires a second verification step in addition to your password. Even if your password is stolen, your account cannot be accessed.

features.title: Bot and spam protection
features.body: Forms and API endpoints are protected by reCAPTCHA. Automated attacks and bulk spam requests are blocked.

features.title: Rate limiting
features.body: If too many requests come in a short time, the system automatically throttles. The first line of defense against brute force attacks.

features.title: GDPR & CCPA compliance
features.body: Personal data is processed and stored in accordance with legal requirements. Data can be completely deleted upon request.

features.title: Encrypted connection
features.body: All data flows on the platform are encrypted via HTTPS. Sensitive information is never visible on open networks.

seoAnalytics.title: SEO, analytics and performance — in one panel
seoAnalytics.description: Google Search Console, GA4, and Chrome UX report in one dashboard. Monitor organic clicks, page speed, and engagement rate without switching between separate tools.

portability.title: Your content on web, mobile, everywhere
portability.description: Craftive's headless REST API delivers the same content to website, mobile app, or third-party integrations simultaneously. You choose the frontend — your data is always yours.

notification.label: Publishing · craftive.io
notification.title: Page delivered to all channels
notification.body: Your web, mobile, and integrations were updated simultaneously.

tabs.label: Agencies
tabs.description: Stop rebuilding infrastructure from scratch for every client. The brief comes in, the foundation is already there — delivery drops to weeks, developer cost drops with it, margin climbs.

tabs.label: SaaS Teams
tabs.description: Stop spending engineers on blog posts, landing pages, and doc sites. Your content team runs them independently — engineers stay focused on the product.

tabs.label: Corporate Brands
tabs.description: Dozens of dealer sites, multiple languages, one hub. Brand identity stays intact at the centre while every site publishes independently — full visibility, full control.

tabs.label: E-commerce
tabs.description: Product pages, campaigns, blog, and store — all in one panel. Launch the season campaign without waiting for a developer; manage stock and content from the same place.

stats.label: Time to add a new language

managedProcess.headline: The process we run on your behalf
managedProcess.subhead: Most platforms just give you a control panel — the rest is on you. Craftive is different: we manage every stage from setup to post-launch support.

tiles.title: Discovery call
tiles.body: We listen to your needs and together determine the right modules and timeline.

tiles.title: Content architecture
tiles.body: We map out your pages, content types, and languages.

tiles.title: Setup and development
tiles.body: We place your brand's visuals and content on top of the ready foundation.

tiles.title: Launch and growth
tiles.body: We stay by your side after going live; add new modules whenever you're ready.

social.headline: From the projects we've built
social.subhead: We build every project on a ready infrastructure, not from scratch — fast, sustainable, and tailored to you.

platformDemo.headline: Tools that simplify daily work
platformDemo.subhead: Your content team edits pages, uploads media, publishes — without waiting for a developer.

tabs.label: SmartEdit
tabs.heading: Edit content without waiting for a developer
tabs.description: With SmartEdit, add components directly on the page, update text, change layouts. Preview and publish instantly without developer involvement.

tabs.label: Media Library
tabs.heading: All media in one hub, ready for every channel
tabs.description: Upload photos, videos, and files; automatic resizing and format conversion is done for you. Everything at hand with search, tags, and folder structure.
features: Single source for web, mobile, and API

tabs.label: Page Builder
tabs.heading: From template to page, live in minutes
tabs.description: Your content team produces new pages with ready templates and reusable components. Since the content architecture is built from the start, every page looks consistent.

items.q: How are you different from Webflow or WordPress?
items.a: Tools like Webflow just give you the design panel; the content architecture, multilingual support, and growth side are left to you. We do the whole thing: from design, to content structure, to launch and ongoing support.

items.q: Wouldn't hiring a developer be better?
items.a: A single developer has to build the entire infrastructure from scratch — which takes months. We work on top of our ready foundation, focusing directly on your actual product; the right outcome emerges in the same time.
We maintain a separate database for each client. Your data doesn't sit in the same place as another brand's data. It works in compliance with GDPR and CCPA.

items.q: If we want to switch later, will we be locked in?
items.a: Your content always belongs to you via an open API. Your data is portable and you can develop the frontend independently. We don't lock you in a closed box.

items.q: How quickly can we go live?
items.a: A typical corporate site goes live within 4–8 weeks. Smaller scope is shorter; e-commerce or multilingual projects can take a bit longer — we give a firm timeline in the first call.
Yes. After going live, modules like multiple languages, e-commerce, and internal portals can be added on top. You grow without having to rewrite anything.

ctaFooter.rightText: Pick a time from our calendar for a 10-minute intro call. We'll answer your questions and show the platform live.
